# Tutorial Sheet 3

## Question 1

A cylinder of radius $r$ rolls along the ground without slipping.

(a) Find its angular velocity at speed $v$.

(b) Find its kinetic energy.

## Question 2

A spring of stiffness $k$ carries a mass $m$.

(a) Find the period of small oscillations.

(b) Find the greatest speed of the mass in an oscillation of amplitude $A$.
